boundedCoverageTargets.target: Interpret the x/y density surface and contour projection as a two-dimensional position uncertainty view, not a three-coordinate pose surface or negative probability.
boundedCoverageTargets.whyUnique: Q020 defines a pose belief but never tests the actual plotted axes/projection; the source explicitly labels 2D Gaussian and position uncertainty.
boundedCoverageTargets.suggestion: Extend Q020 or add one bounded figure interpretation. Do not require unsupported precise numeric peak/mean reconstruction.

boundedCoverageTargets.target: Explicitly distinguish measurement conditional independence p(z_t|history,current state)=p(z_t|x_t) from controlled transition p(x_t|x_(t-1),u_t).
boundedCoverageTargets.whyUnique: Q024 tests only the transition equation; Q021 graph arrows and Q029 generic scope do not require the measurement history screening-off relation.
boundedCoverageTargets.suggestion: Extend Q024 to a parallel paired relation rather than adding a duplicate Bayes-normalization calculation.

boundedCoverageTargets.target: Distinguish simulated odometry returned by .step, predicted mean via .f, and covariance Jacobians .Fx/.Fv.
boundedCoverageTargets.whyUnique: Q065 covers q property and Q089 covers RandomPath versus EKF; neither tests these actual named source methods or their estimation roles.
boundedCoverageTargets.suggestion: Extend Q089 or add one bounded same-domain role mapping, preserving q/step and simulation-versus-estimation distinctions.

notCountedAsGaps: No extra historical-name trivia or duplicate simple time-step arithmetic is required.
Angular-wheel-speed versus tangential-speed conversion is already included in the drive solution, so not counted as a new unique gap.
Sensor-noise mapping and nonlinear covariance are already represented by equations and worked questions, not missing merely because there is no second numerical variant.
batchQualityNote: The authored option-key positions repeat o1,o4,o3,o2. Individual responses were independently derived and frozen, not inferred from this pattern. Preserve option shuffling in the application; do not expose an unshuffled predictable practice key sequence.
